class.name: PorchlightAction
class.brief_description: Completes or removes a Porchlight milestone.
class.description: A reusable action that changes persistent milestone state through [PorchlightProgress]. Use [member operation] to choose whether [member milestone] is completed or removed when [method execute] is called. Executing an action that would not change the current milestone state returns [code]false[/code].

method.name: execute
method.description: Performs the configured [member operation] on [member milestone]. Returns [code]true[/code] if the persistent milestone state changed. Returns [code]false[/code] if the milestone is empty, the requested state was already active, or the [PorchlightProgress] singleton is unavailable. Emits [signal executed] after a valid milestone operation is attempted.

method.name: get_description
method.description: Returns a readable description of the configured operation and milestone. If no milestone is selected, returns [code]No milestone selected.[/code].

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [member milestone] contains a nonempty milestone name.

members.member: The milestone changed by this action. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed when assigned.

signal.name: executed
signal.description: Emitted after an operation is attempted on a valid [param milestone]. [param changed] is [code]true[/code] when the persistent milestone state changed.

constants.constant: Completes [member milestone] when [method execute] is called.
Removes [member milestone] when [method execute] is called.
